conceptCards.title: Web Workers and dedicated worker threads
conceptCards.summary: A Web Worker runs JavaScript on a separate thread with its own event loop — no DOM access, but perfect for parsing large CSV files, crypto, or image processing without freezing ...

conceptCards.title: postMessage, structured clone, and transferables
conceptCards.summary: postMessage copies most data via the structured clone algorithm — expensive for large ArrayBuffers.

conceptCards.title: SharedArrayBuffer and Atomics
conceptCards.summary: SharedArrayBuffer lets Workers and the main thread read the same memory — but without Atomics, you get data races.

conceptCards.title: Worker pools and offloading CPU work
conceptCards.summary: One Worker processes one CPU job at a time.

conceptCards.title: Workers versus C# threads and Task.Run
